lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A dense grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular pixel clusters located posterior to the branchial slits, organized into roughly horizontal rows and vertical columns.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Distinct vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to create a coordinate-like grid on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent linear feature running horizontally across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A clear distribution of high-luminance blobs localized within the boundary of the first dorsal fin silhouette visible in the upper right frame.

other_distinctive_markers: Highly visible pectoral fin displaying a high density of circular high-luminance blobs consistent with the lateral flank patterning.
